# Agent HQ

> Open-source, local-first AI agent hub. One Rust binary runs a chat agent on Discord, Telegram, a web app and the terminal, keeps data in a markdown vault on your own machine, and supervises coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex. MIT licensed, version 0.9.x.

- [Install guide](https://agent-hq.online/install/): curl script, Homebrew, npx, Docker and server setup
- [Architecture](https://agent-hq.online/architecture/): how the daemon, vault, relays and MCP gateway fit together
- [Compare](https://agent-hq.online/compare/): Agent HQ next to OpenClaw and Hermes Agent
- [Security](https://agent-hq.online/security/): sandbox, signed releases, reporting a vulnerability
- [Source code](https://github.com/CalvinMagezi/hq): repository, issues and changelog
- [Agent setup guide](https://github.com/CalvinMagezi/hq/blob/main/AGENTS-SETUP.md): a file you can hand to your own AI agent so it installs HQ for you
